```
:root {
  --primary: #4f46e5;
  --primary-dark: #4338ca;
  --dark: #111827;
  --gray: #6b7280;
  --light-bg: #f9fafb;
  --border: #e5e7eb;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

body {
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
  color: var(--dark);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.container {
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}

h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; }

a { text-decoration: none; }

ul { list-style: none; }

/* Navbar */
.navbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: #fff;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  z-index: 100;
}

.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  height: 70px;
}

.logo {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--dark);
}

.logo span { color: var(--primary); }

nav ul {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 32px;
}

nav a {
  color: var(--dark);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.btn-nav {
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff !important;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn-primary {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 14px 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); }

.btn-outline {
  display: inline-block;
  border: 2px solid var(--primary);
  color: var(--primary);
  padding: 12px 26px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.btn-outline:hover { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; }

/* Hero */
.hero {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eef2ff, #f9fafb);
  padding: 100px 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.hero h1 {
  font-size: 2.6rem;
  max-width: 750px;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
}

.hero p {
  color: var(--gray);
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0 auto 30px;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

/* Sections */
section {
  padding: 90px 0;
}

section h2 {
  font-size: 2rem;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.section-sub {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--gray);
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0 auto 50px;
}

/* Process Steps */
.steps {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 30px;
}

.step {
  background: var(--light-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 30px;
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.step-num {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.step h3 { margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.step p { color: var(--gray); font-size: 0.95rem; }

/* Redesign section */
.redesign {
  background: var(--light-bg);
  padding: 70px 0;
}

.redesign-text {
  max-width: 700px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.redesign-text p { color: var(--gray); margin-top: 16px; }

/* Packages */
.package-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
  gap: 30px;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.package-card {
  position: relative;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 40px 30px;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.package-card.featured {
  border: 2px solid var(--primary);
  transform: scale(1.03);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.15);
}

.badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -14px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.package-card h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }

.price {
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.price span {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--gray);
}

.package-card ul {
  text-align: left;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.package-card li {
  padding: 8px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--gray);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.package-card li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

/* Marketing section */
.marketing {
  background: var(--light-bg);
}

.marketing-text {
  max-width: 750px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.marketing-text p { color: var(--gray); margin: 16px 0 30px; }

.checklist {
  text-align: left;
  display: inline-block;
}

.checklist li {
  padding: 8px 0;
  color: var(--dark);
}

.checklist li::before {
  content: "✓ ";
  color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* CTA / Contact */
.cta {
  background: var(--dark);
  color: #fff;
  text-align: center;
}

.cta h2 { color: #fff; }
.cta p { color: #d1d5db; max-width: 550px; margin: 0 auto 30px; }

.contact-form {
  max-width: 500px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.contact-form input,
.contact-form textarea {
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: none;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.contact-form button { align-self: center; margin-top: 8px; }

/* Footer */
footer {
  background: #0b0f1a;
  color: #9ca3af;
  padding: 30px 0;
}

.footer-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}

footer .logo { color: #fff; }
footer .logo span { color: var(--primary); }

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  nav ul { gap: 16px; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 2rem; }
  .package-card.featured { transform: none; }
}

```
